title: Native quadratic-twist selection, exact finite base audits, and charged relation search
status_note: Native CLI and correctness fixtures are implemented. No scheduler submission, lease, new performance result, or cloud run is claimed. Freeze a merged source pin, checkpoint/recovery contract, and independent evidence/admission before scheduler-ready promotion.
question: Can public quadratic-twist coordinate structure reduce complete original-curve relation and target-solving cost relative to matched ordinary bases?
decision_value: An exact coverage effect identifies which fixed-base heuristics deserve a cheaper public selector, but only lower complete native solving cost can promote an algorithmic improvement. Counterexamples, rank loss, failed samples and preprocessing regressions determine whether to change selection, relation arity or the useful-information criterion without declaring a universal obstruction.

resources.notes: Proposed caps, not measured estimates. Native executable deadline is enforced by the runner; benchmark attempt budget is 1000*n per solve. Exact default fields are in PROTOCOL.md. No funding or capacity reservation.
